notes: Summary: LatticeBridge is a multi-tenant ecommerce platform (marketplace + storefronts). Main pain: agent wait times during promos; tickets balloon and L1 agents need fast summarization + suggested actions.
Key quote from Head of CX: 'If agents have a reliable assist under 300ms at 10k concurrent conversations, we can route more to LLM-assisted flow and reduce escalation.'

Workload specifics: real-time agent-assist (small context windows), ticket summarization for triage, outbound template generation, automated partial case updates via tool-calling (Zendesk API, Salesforce case comments).
Traffic profile: baseline 2k reqs/min, Black Friday peak ~16k reqs/min (expected bursts up to 25k for flash sales), spikes linked to marketing campaigns and payment incidents.
Latency targets: 95th < 500ms, 99th < 1200ms for assistant snippets; SRE asking for 99th < 300ms for critical paths (agent UI).

Throughput/Caching notes: prefix caching for common product inquiries, KV cache for session history, recommendation to use dedicated pools + auto-burst policy. Preference for model routing (large model for rewrites/summaries, smaller quantized model for short assist to save cost).

Security/integration: strict EU data residency for EU customers' PII; require KMS integration and full audit logs for automated tool actions; SSO via SAML across CX apps; 7-year retention asked by compliance for audit trails (legal flag).
POC scope requested by SE: 72h load test with simulated flash sales, demo of graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model + queue shedding) and end-to-end tool-call with audit entry in Zendesk.
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Will accept dedicated fees if predictable unit cost and clear savings during normal ops (Optimize recommendations important).
Action items: provide runbook + synthetic load plan, share TCO model for Dedicated vs Private, obtain security whitepaper on data residency and HSM/KMS flow.
